name: Ten no Hikari wa Koi no Hoshi
source:
Mitsuhiko attends Seiyou Gakuen and one night, his childhood friend Rio was going to confess to him when there was a loud noise. He sees his classmate Koiboshi on the rooftop with a blank look on her face. Not listening to their calls, she falls from the roof. He runs to catch her, but her body is surrounded by a mysterious light and he falls unconscious. When he wakes up and found himself and the school in a very deep hole. He gathers the remaining students and teachers and begins to find a way out of this hole.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
光彦就读于星阳学园。一天夜里，青梅竹马里樱正准备向他告白，突然传来一声巨响。他看见同学恋星站在屋顶，神情空洞。恋星没有理会两人的呼喊，从屋顶坠落。光彦冲上前想接住她，但她的身体被神秘光芒包围，光彦也失去了意识。醒来后，他发现自己和整座学校都落入了一个极深的坑洞。他召集幸存的师生，开始寻找逃离这里的方法。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
